name: Saint-Aubin 1er Cru « Derrière chez Édouard »
description: A taut, mineral Chardonnay from a single Saint-Aubin parcel, all citrus pith and wet stone with a saline finish.
sommelierNotes: Pour alongside a chilled seafood tower or a soft-ripened cheese course.

name: Côtes du Rhône Villages
description: A warm, generous blend of Grenache and Syrah with garrigue, dark cherry, and a peppery lift.
sommelierNotes: An easy, food-friendly pour for roasted lamb or a Sunday table.

name: Estate Cabernet Sauvignon
description: Structured and dark-fruited, with cassis, cedar, and a long, tannic finish built for the cellar.
sommelierNotes: Decant an hour ahead; pairs naturally with a dry-aged ribeye.
